title: HP Recovery Between Long Rests
dataSources: Character sheets (`rpg:character`), VTT sessions (`rpg:session`), initiative rounds (`rpg:initiative`), encounters (`rpg:combat`), campaign ops (`rpg:ops`).
app: Tabletop campaign telemetry — D&D Beyond character exports, Roll20 session logs, initiative trackers, and campaign asset checklists — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rpg:character class_name=* hp_recovered_pct=*
| stats avg(hp_recovered_pct) as avg_hp_recovered_pct, count as events by class_name
| sort - avg_hp_recovered_pct
description: Shows average HP recovered percentage by class for long-rest recovery.
value: Average HP recovered percentage by class helps compare long-rest recovery across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `hp_recovered_pct` on `rpg:character` events and normalize `class_name` so Splunk can summarize performance by class.
visualization: Bar chart of average HP recovered percentage by class.
grandmaExplanation: It turns the average HP recovered percentage for each class so you can see what works best for long-rest recovery.
